key.name: zabbix-url
key.description: Base URL of the Zabbix Web Frontend (e.g. https://zabbix.example.com).

key.name: api-token
key.description: Personal API token generated in Zabbix User Settings.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the extension polls Zabbix API for active problems.

key.name: min-severity
key.description: 0: Not classified, 1: Info, 2: Warning, 3: Average, 4: High, 5: Disaster.

key.name: only-unacknowledged
key.description: Filter out acknowledged problems from the alert list.

key.name: show-count
key.description: Display the number of active problems next to the panel icon.

key.name: enable-notifications
key.description: Notify when the number of active problems increases or decreases.
